# Termux-Playwright (v1.0.0)
> Non-Root Real Chromium Automation & CDP Control Package for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-playwright-demo
- Installation: `pip install termux-playwright
# or:
npm install termux-playwright`
- Architecture: Directly interfaces with Termux Chromium via Chrome DevTools Protocol over isolated Unix domain sockets, enabling full scraping and automation with zero root requirements.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_playwright import TermuxBrowser

browser = TermuxBrowser.launch(headless=True)
page = browser.new_page()
page.goto("https://uno-km.vercel.app")
page.screenshot(path="termux_capture.png")
browser.close()
```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
